title: Large Discovery Models: Empirically-grounded Model-Based Open-Ended Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.15669v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific discovery often involves optimising expensive-to-evaluate objectives over vast, structured, and open-ended hypothesis spaces, such as molecules, protein sequences, and computer programs. Generative models such as large language models (LLMs) provide expressive priors over such spaces, but their likelihoods and self-assessments are unreliable proxies for the objectives and calibrated epistemic uncertainty, especially for novel candidates outside the observed data distribution. We introduce the Large Discovery Model (LDM), an empirically grounded recurrent architecture that couples a generative model with a Bayesian non-parametric reward surrogate model. The generative model proposes and refines candidate designs, while the surrogate predicts their performance and quantifies uncertainty, yielding an uncertainty-aware value that guides candidate generation, refinement, and selection. translated_title: 大型发现模型：基于经验构建的模型驱动开放式搜索
translated_abstract: 科学发现通常涉及在广阔、结构化且开放式的假设空间（如分子、蛋白质序列和计算机程序）中优化评估成本高昂的目标。生成模型，如大型语言模型（LLMs），为这些空间提供了富有表现力的先验，但其似然性和自我评估作为目标和校准认知不确定性的代理是不可靠的，尤其是对于观察数据分布之外的新颖候选者。我们引入了大型发现模型（LDM），一种基于经验的循环架构，将生成模型与贝叶斯非参数奖励代理模型耦合。生成模型提出并改进候选设计，而代理模型预测其性能并量化不确定性，产生一种不确定性感知的价值，用于指导候选生成、改进和选择。发现记忆和代理模型共同协作，以支持开放式搜索过程。
tldr: 本文提出了一种大型发现模型（LDM），通过结合生成模型与贝叶斯非参数代理模型，实现了对开放假设空间中新颖候选的高效、不确定性感知的搜索与优化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Large Discovery Model (LDM), which couples a generative model with a Bayesian non-parametric surrogate to enable uncertainty-aware, efficient search over open-ended hypothesis spaces.
